title: チューリップ賞にむけて

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Daiwa Scarlet is locked and loaded for the Tulip Sho.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: To her surprise, it turns out her rival, Vodka, is running there as well.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She vows to beat Vodka and prove that she's number one.
